title: Apply to register a trailer or caravan
summary: This page explains the process and requirements for registering a trailer or caravan on NSW roads.
intro:
If you want to tow a caravan or trailer on NSW roads, you must get it registered at a Service NSW Centre.

Note: When you register, if your caravan or camper trailer weighs from 255kg up to 4.5 tonnes, you'll automatically get a 40% reduction on the vehicle tax.
who_can_apply: Must tow a caravan or trailer on NSW roads
what_you_need: A previous registration receipt or other proof of registration entitlement
An original inspection report issued within the last 42 days, which can be:
A Vehicle Safety Compliance Certificate (if the vehicle was significantly modified)

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and submit the application.

more_info.text: A weighbridge ticket is required if:
Caravans and camper trailers are exempt from stamp duty.

internal_links.text: Authorised Unregistered Vehicle Inspection Scheme report (blue slip)
Heavy Vehicle Authorised Inspection Scheme report

faqs.q: Do I need to register a caravan or trailer to use it on NSW roads?
faqs.a: Yes, if you plan to tow a caravan or trailer on NSW roads, you must get it registered at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What tax reduction is available for certain caravans or campers?
faqs.a: If your caravan or camper trailer weighs from 255kg up to 4.5 tonnes, you will automatically receive a 40% reduction on the vehicle tax.

faqs.q: Where can I submit my application?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre to submit your application.
